text: Fixed-geometry court separates anatomical susceptibility from lighting emphasis. Raw neighboring-normal angles are lowest in far-anterior y octiles (about 1.40-1.51 degrees) and higher across middle/posterior bands (about 2.08-2.45), but peak local brightness variation moves when the light moves: current light peaks at left/right bins 5/3, anterior-superior mirror at 3/6, and superior-only at 3/5. Therefore the regional rough appearance is neither a geometry discontinuity nor a mesh4s failure: the normal field supplies susceptibility and lighting selects the emphasized band. Of tested QA-only filters, edge-preserving 5x0.25 with 5-degree feature scale is the better experimental direction; it retains 9.8-10.5 percent mean light-variation reduction while reducing extreme angular movement versus uniform 5x0.25. No production default adopted.
